title: Refined storefront scrolling
summary: Softened the page scrollbar and improved section-scroll spacing and reduced-motion behavior.

changes.detail: Replaced vivid green scrollbar with rounded sage-green thumb, pale track and darker hover/drag feedback; slim touch scrollbar and stable desktop gutter.
Added 96px scroll padding for sticky-header clearance and disabled CSS smooth scrolling under reduced-motion preferences. Added system-color scrollbar fallback for forced-colors mode.
